mapper.sql: select s.submission_id, s.assignment_id, s.student_id, s.content, s.attachment_url, s.submitted_at, s.grade, s.feedback, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, st.student_no, st.name as student_name, a.title as assignment_title, a.total_score from edu_submission s left join edu_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id left join edu_assignment a on a.assignment_id = s.assignment_id
mapper.select: inner join edu_course_offering o on o.offering_id = a.offering_id where o.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and a.del_flag = '0' order by s.submitted_at desc, s.submission_id desc
where s.student_id = #{studentId} order by s.submitted_at desc, s.submission_id desc

select count(1) from edu_submission s inner join edu_assignment a on a.assignment_id = s.assignment_id and a.del_flag = '0' inner join edu_course_offering o on o.offering_id = a.offering_id where o.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and s.status = 'SUBMITTED'

select count(1) from edu_assignment a inner join edu_course_offering o on o.offering_id = a.offering_id inner join edu_enrollment e on e.offering_id = o.offering_id and e.status in ('ENROLLED', 'COMPLETED') where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and e.student_id = #{studentId} and not exists ( select 1 from edu_submission s where s.assignment_id = a.assignment_id and s.student_id = #{studentId} )
mapper.insert: insert into edu_submission ( assignment_id, student_id, content, attachment_url, submitted_at, grade, feedback, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{content}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{submittedAt}, #{grade}, #{feedback}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update edu_submission set grade = #{grade}, feedback = #{feedback}, status = 'GRADED', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where submission_id = #{submissionId}
